map.通过观察目光、面色、神情、体态判断神的盛衰，辨识得神、少神、失神、假神（基于《中: Judge the abundance or decline of the spirit from gaze, complexion, expression and posture, identifying full spirit, deficient spirit, lost spirit and false spirit (based on the spirit observation content of TCM Inspection)
map.望神按目光、面色、神情、体态四项判断：得神（目光明亮、面色荣润、神志清楚、体态自: Spirit observation judges four aspects: gaze, complexion, expression and posture. Full spirit (bright gaze, lustrous complexion, clear consciousness, relaxed posture) means abundant essence and qi; deficient spirit (dull gaze, pale complexion, fatigue) means insufficient essence and qi; lost spirit (dim gaze, dull complexion, clouded mind and confused speech) means depleted essence and failing spirit; false spirit (sudden brightening in chronic illness, flushed face as if made up) is a critical sign of yin-yang separation.

map.勾选观察到的表现后点击「判断神之盛衰」: After ticking the observed findings, click "Judge the abundance or decline of the spirit"
map.💡 望神是望诊之首。\"神\"是人体生命活动的外在表现，反映正气盛衰。得神为佳，: 💡 Spirit observation is the first of inspection methods. The "spirit" is the outward manifestation of the body's life activity and reflects the strength of upright qi. Full spirit is favourable, lost spirit is critical, and false spirit signals impending death (the last flare of vitality).
map.📋 四种神的辨识对照: 📋 Comparison of the four types of spirit
map.精气充足，神气旺盛: Abundant essence and qi, vigorous vitality
map.正气未伤，病情轻浅，预后良好: Upright qi unharmed, mild illness, good prognosis
map.正气受损，见于虚证或病后恢复期: Upright qi damaged, seen in deficiency syndromes or convalescence
map.精气大亏，神气衰败: Greatly depleted essence and qi, failing spirit
map.正气大伤，病情严重，预后不良: Upright qi severely damaged, serious illness, poor prognosis
map.精气将竭，虚假神旺: Essence and qi about to be exhausted, false vitality
map.回光返照，残灯复明，病危先兆: The last flare of vitality, a guttering lamp relit, a sign of impending danger
map.目面身合参: Combined reading of eyes, face and body
map.勾选「目光骤亮、言语不休、欲食」等→scores.fake 最多→判「假神」（回: Ticking items such as "suddenly bright eyes, incessant speech, desire to eat" gives the highest false-spirit score → judged "false spirit" (last flare), a critical warning sign.
map.目有神、面色润、反应敏→good 类最多→「得神」，正气未伤，预后佳。: Eyes with spirit, moist complexion, quick reaction give the most full-spirit hits → "full spirit", upright qi unharmed with good prognosis.
map.重点看目光、面色、形态、反应；得神/少神/失神/假神四级。: Focus on gaze, complexion, form and reaction; four levels of full spirit, deficient spirit, lost spirit and false spirit.
map.假神是临终突现「好转」假象，临床极危，勿误判为康复。: False spirit is a sudden apparent "improvement" before death and is extremely critical clinically. Never mistake it for recovery.
